blockers.summary: Whitepaper canonical Lattice syntax is absent from the current EBNF.
JSON field shapes conflict with Whitepaper sections 6.1-6.9.
Permission vocabularies, ordering and fields conflict with Whitepaper section 10.
Packet identity versus context identity and envelope shape need explicit reconciliation.
Lattice parser, canonical model, compiler and semantic validator are unimplemented.
Carrier serialization, runtime boundary and policy conformance are unimplemented.
Full protocol positive/negative, round-trip, hostile-input and interoperability evidence is absent.
Whitepaper source figure files and reproducible publication build are missing.
Final clean release audit, compatibility evidence, migration policy and pre-training freeze are incomplete.
